newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH FIXTURES AUGUST 9-10.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ENGLISH AND SCOTTISH FIXTURES AUGUST 9-10.

text.p: English and Scottish league and cup fixtures for August 9 and 10:

English premier league - Barnsley v West Ham, Blackburn v Derby County, Coventry v Chelsea, Everton v Crystal Palace, Leeds v Arsenal, Leicester v Aston Villa, Newcastle v Sheffield Wednesday, Southampton v Bolton, Wimbledon v Liverpool.

English division one - Birmingham v Stoke, Bradford v Stockport, Bury v Reading, Manchester City v Portsmouth, Middlesbrough v Charlton, Norwich v Wolverhampton, Oxford United v Huddersfield, Port Vale v Nottingham Forest, Queens Park Rangers v Ipswich, Swindon v Crewe, West Bromwich v Tranmere.

English division two - Blackpool v Luton, Bristol Rovers v Plymouth, Chesterfield v Walsall, Fulham v Wrexham, Gillingham v Preston, Grimsby v Bristol City, Millwall v Brentford, Northampton v Bournemouth, Oldham v York, Southend v Carlisle, Watford v Burnley, Wigan v Wycombe.

English division three - Chester v Lincoln, Colchester v Darlington, Exeter v Hartlepool, Leyton Orient v Cardiff, Macclesfield v Torquay, Mansfield v Hull, Notts County v Rochdale, Peterborough v Scunthorpe, Rotherham v Barnet, Scarborough v Cambridge United, Shrewsbury v Doncaster, Swansea v Brighton.

Scottish League Cup second round - Queen of South v Dundee United, Berwick v Celtic, Dumbarton v Aberdeen, Dundee v East Stirling, Dunfermline v Ayr, East Fife v Kilmarnock, Greenock Morton v Airdrieonians, Hibernian v Alloa, Livingston v Hearts, Motherwell v Inverness Thistle, Partick v Stirling, Raith v Forfar, Ross County v Falkirk, St Johnstone v Clyde, St Mirren v Clydebank.
